title: A Humble Heart Says Thank You
story: The King Who Forgot to Stay Humble
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Uzziah was a young, strong king,
Who sought the Lord, and so
He built tall towers, won his fights,
And God helped him to grow.

[Chorus]
A humble heart says, “Thank You, Lord,
For blessings, big and small,”
I know my good things come from God,
He gives them, one and all.

[Verse 2]
But when he grew so big and strong,
He got so proud one day,
He went inside the temple and
Broke God’s rules anyway.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes and whisper thanks
For all that God has done,
A humble heart stays close to Him,
Good night, my little one.

[Chorus]
mood: Thankful music. A low, slow, breathing sway moves under the voice, soft and unshowy, like a heart bowing rather than standing tall, matching a king who did great things and then forgot where they came from. The chorus is warm and grateful, with a small dip of sadness in the second verse where pride creeps in. By the last verse the sway is slower and lower still, settling into a hushed, humble goodnight.
